mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at the Verona Public Library with a current temperature of 50 degrees and a first quarter moon overhead.
In city news, the Common Council approved a zoning and sign ordinance overhaul, and remember to double-check your designated polling location before the next election.
There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with live music today at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus yoga sessions tomorrow at Insight Wellness.

Regarding local safety, the Verona Police Department reported an incident last Thursday where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I after being observed driving dangerously with students on board.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy their flavor of the day, Mint Cookie, as the restaurant is currently open to serve you.
